titles.ja: あやかしトライアングル

1.overview: Matsuri, an exorcist ninja, encounters Shirogane, an ayakashi targeting his childhood friend, Suzu, who seems to have something "special" about her.
1.summary:
Matsuri, an exorcist ninja, encounters Shirogane, an ayakashi targeting his childhood friend, Suzu, who seems to have something "special" about her.
Source: crunchyroll

2.overview: Having had Gender Swap Awakened cast on him, Matsuri enters high school as a girl. There, Shirogane attacks in a bid to take the God-Sealing Scroll, but the ayakashi Tadare goes after Suzu instead. Matsuri saves her and decides to become on of Suzu's girl friends.
2.summary:
Having had Gender Swap Awakened cast on him, Matsuri enters high school as a girl. There, Shirogane attacks in a bid to take the God-Sealing Scroll, but the ayakashi Tadare goes after Suzu instead. Matsuri saves her and decides to become one of Suzu`s girl friends.
Source: Crunchyroll

3.overview: Suzu makes Suzu-dumplings, trying to become friends with Shirogane. Matsuri sees her and reminisces about the times he admired her for her ability to befriend ayakashi. That's when they get a visit from the Lightning-Fast Exorcist Ninja, Ninokuru Souga.
3.summary:

Source: Crunchyroll

title.en: The Melancholy of the Ayakashi Medium

4.overview: Matsuri does his best to fit in as one of Suzu's girl friends, but he doesn't know how to act around Yayoi and Lucy. Yayoi, in turn, wants to get to know Matsuri better too, but she keeps tripping and getting up close and personal, which complciates matters. She believes Matsuri despises her now, but the cause was actually an ayakashi!

5.overview: The Suzu that showed up in Matsuri's room was actually an omokage shadow, a cloning ayakashi. What's more, it's still wandering around somewhere, which poses a real threat to Suzu's life. Matsuri and Shirogane frantically scour the town for it.

title.en: Those Who See, and Those Who Can`t

6.overview: Lucy shows Matsuri and Suzu a photo she took, which seems to be a spirit photo! Captured in it is an "Ikon" a cluster of human resentment, which then proceeds to possess Lucy herself. Matsuri must find a way to exorcise the ayakashi and protect her!

7.overview: The battle with the Jinyo intensifies, and Shirogane has to fend him off with Suzu in tow!
7.summary:
Matsuri and Suzu receive a visit from a traveling artist, and he has a surprise or two in store for them!
Source: crunchyroll

8.overview: Having lost his powers, Shirogane now has a problem he has to deal with, and a proposition for Suzu and Matsuri.
8.summary:
Suzu`s experiment leads to Matsuri`s gear malfunctioning, so they decide to pay a visit to expert artisan, Korogi Reo.
Source: crunchyroll

9.summary:
UFOs, catnip, incense, and alerts galore! After the visit to the Korogi store, Matsuri has high expectations for his new ninja gear. But he doesn`t expect what happens while he`s trying it out!
Source: crunchyroll

10.summary:

Source: crunchyroll
